method.parser: Python standard-library ElementTree.iterparse of every XML element and all worksheet rows/cells; no lxml or workbook import/recalculation. Shared strings resolved in source order, row elements cleared after processing.
method.integrity: Fresh outer ZIP SHA256/size against pinned inventory, every member EOF/CRC32/SHA256, every internal part EOF/CRC32/SHA256.
method.numeric: Decimal from exact serialized <v> text, never Python float. Numeric identifiers remain lexemes, without inferred leading zeros, recovery of lost source digits or entity meanings. Style indices and per-column serialized types are retained.
method.dates: Workbook date1904 flag determines epoch; integral date serials converted with Excel 1900 leap-day handling. Fractional/phantom/unresolved dates are not silently coerced. Source serials remain retained in typed distinct counters.
method.duplicates: Full source values and typed values grouped using exact JSON byte keys in local SQLite. Trim-only and numeric/date-normalized diagnostics separate. Ordinal omitted from row-content comparisons and tested independently where present. No rows removed.
method.memory: One compressed workbook buffer, shared-string table, one parsed row and bounded 5000-row SQLite batches; 16 MiB database page cache.
method.privacy: Published JSON contains aggregates and bounded numeric/date/error/row locators, not investor/custodian/broker/transaction identifiers, security names or author metadata. Custodian code distributions are withheld alongside raw party and transaction identifiers. Custom XML and document properties are parsed/count-hashed without exposing their arbitrary text.
method.rendering: Serialized-content audit only. No visual formatting verification, native Excel execution or formula recalculation was requested or performed.

arithmetic_policy.residual: Exact serialized Decimal(RATE) * Decimal(QUANTITY) - Decimal(VALUE (in Rs)).
arithmetic_policy.fixed_diagnostics: Exact zero, abs <= 0.005 rupee, abs <= 0.01 rupee.
arithmetic_policy.hypothetical_bound: abs(QUANTITY)*0.00005 + 0.005, only as a hypothetical nearest-rounded 4dp RATE and 2dp VALUE compatibility check. Not a discovered source rounding policy or transaction-validity contract.
arithmetic_policy.precision_limit: Serialized numeric lexeme precision is not displayed precision or economic accuracy. General format and long binary-conversion decimal tails are retained, not corrected or rounded away. Aggregated VALUE is not buy/sell-signed institutional net flow.

consumer_limits: Historical masked transaction reports, not OHLCV bars, domestic-institution flows, shareholding balances, EPS/P-E estimates or current five-session evidence.

This offline audit does not apply transaction/exchange/instrument code meanings, correction/cancellation/revision semantics, stable masked-party identity or historical-to-current security mappings. Parent-owned official source contract is separate.
Trade date and report date must remain separate; archive/package timestamps are not publication availability or market freshness.

Syntax-valid/checksum-valid ISINs do not establish present listing eligibility or corporate-action continuity. Numeric identifiers may have pre-existing spreadsheet coercion; original pre-workbook spelling is unavailable.
No importer, runtime consumer, Mongo contents, live source availability, dashboard readiness or production behavior was changed or proved.
Duplicate and candidate-key findings are per worksheet/member. Cross-member or cross-month uniqueness is not established by this artifact.

independent_replay.residual_sign_policy: Owned product-minus-value is compared with negative independent value-minus-product; exact Decimal arithmetic, no float coercion.
independent_replay.duplicate_comparability: Shared trim-only row and custodian+transaction diagnostics compared. Broader owned date/numeric normalization and other key variants have no independent replay equivalent; no cross-archive uniqueness claimed.
independent_replay.compared: Fresh outer archive pins and hashes; member and all internal package hashes/bytes/CRC; shared strings, row/cell/header/type accounting, raw categorical code counts excluding custodian identifiers, full daily/monthly date histograms/ranges/lags, exact numeric sums/min/max/zero/negative/fractional counts, common residual counts/max/signed sums with sign conversion, ISIN syntax/checksum/distinct counts, common trim-only row and custodian+transaction key diagnostics.
